numeric_implementation_fidelity.rule: uat_t8103.c equals archived C001 after exactly six translated-to-has_pa identifier substitutions; no numeric or control-flow change.

abi.meaning: has_pa is presence of a decoded next-table/output-page base, including zero, not VA translation. No offset or table walk is performed.

validation.c_cpp_link: PASS: C implementation compiled with cc; direct-header C++ caller compiled separately with c++; linked and executed encode/decode, nonzero page offset and block refusal.
validation.old_header_negative_control: PASS: identical C++ caller compiles with frozen C001, carries mangled uat_decode unresolved symbol, then fails link against the same C object with uat_decode in the linker error.
validation.numeric_differential: PASS: exact Python003 oracle; 4096 flags for page/table/block, seeded PA/ASID ranges, reserved/canonical bounds, nonzero block offsets and output preservation.
